title: Book II, Aphorisms XXXVIII–XLIII
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Book II, Aphorisms XXXVIII–XLIII, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 212–230. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: The five instances of the lamp, which aid the senses: instances of the door, such as the microscope and telescope, citing instances, which bring to the senses what cannot be perceived directly, instances of the road, which follow nature's gradual motions, and supplementary and lancing instances.
